jotai atom (primitive).description:
Create a primitive atom holding one value. Requires atom from jotai.

创建持有单个值的原子；需要从 jotai 导入 atom。

jotai atom (read-only derived).description:
Derive a read-only atom from other atoms; it recomputes when a dependency changes. Requires atom from jotai.

由其他原子派生只读原子，依赖变化时自动重算；需要从 jotai 导入 atom。

jotai atom (writable derived).description:
Derive an atom with custom write behaviour, so reads and writes can differ. Requires atom from jotai.

派生带自定义写行为的原子，使读与写可以不同；需要从 jotai 导入 atom。

jotai useAtom.description:
Read and write an atom, subscribing this component to its value. Requires useAtom from jotai.

读写原子，并让该组件订阅其值；需要从 jotai 导入 useAtom。

jotai useAtomValue.description:
Read an atom without subscribing to a setter. Requires useAtomValue from jotai.

只读取原子，不获取 setter；需要从 jotai 导入 useAtomValue。

jotai useSetAtom.description:
Get an atom's setter without subscribing to its value, so writing does not re-render this component. Requires useSetAtom from jotai.

只取原子的 setter 而不订阅其值，写入不会触发该组件重渲染；需要从 jotai 导入 useSetAtom。

jotai atomWithStorage.description:
Create an atom persisted to localStorage. Requires atomWithStorage from jotai/utils and a browser environment.

创建持久化到 localStorage 的原子；需要从 jotai/utils 导入 atomWithStorage，并运行在浏览器环境。

jotai selectAtom.description:
Subscribe to one slice of a larger atom, re-rendering only when that slice changes. Requires selectAtom from jotai/utils.

只订阅较大原子中的一个切片，仅该切片变化时才重渲染；需要从 jotai/utils 导入 selectAtom。

jotai splitAtom.description:
Split a list atom into one atom per item, so a row re-renders without the whole list. Requires splitAtom from jotai/utils.

把列表原子拆成逐项的原子，使单行重渲染不牵动整个列表；需要从 jotai/utils 导入 splitAtom。

jotai atomFamily.description:
Create atoms keyed by a parameter. Remove entries with its own remove method to avoid unbounded growth. Requires atomFamily from jotai/utils.

按参数创建一族原子；用其 remove 方法清理条目，避免无限增长。需要从 jotai/utils 导入 atomFamily。

jotai loadable.description:
Wrap an async atom so it yields loading, hasData or hasError instead of suspending. Requires loadable from jotai/utils.

包裹异步原子，使其返回 loading / hasData / hasError 而不触发 Suspense；需要从 jotai/utils 导入 loadable。

jotai Provider with store (JavaScript).description:
Scope atoms to an explicit store instead of the implicit global one. Requires jotai 2.

把原子作用域绑定到显式 store，而非隐式全局 store；需要 jotai 2。

jotai Provider with store (TypeScript).description:
Scope atoms to an explicit store instead of the implicit global one. Requires jotai 2 and ReactNode from react.

把原子作用域绑定到显式 store，而非隐式全局 store；需要 jotai 2 和 react 的 ReactNode。
